title: fs009圣灵追随fs010神话驾到
content_zh:
FS009圣灵追随
魔武世界中，文森的一位神话级强者朋友，曾经在圣灵级的时候，因为争夺紫菱精髓，从而导致陨落。
但是，陨落之后的圣灵，并没有永远的沉寂，而是破而后立，登上神坛，成就了一段浴火重生的神话！
而产生这样根本变化的原因，则是那位陨落的圣灵，是一位魔药神匠！
他掌握了一份传承自远古的魔药配方，能够让破碎的魔力之源重生！
文森也知道这个魔药配方，而且，无尽之空里面，大部分魔药都有。只是缺少一些深渊中特有的魔药罢了。
想到这里，文森站起来走向克索斯，径直坐在克索斯旁边的椅子上。
克索斯脸色不自然的苍白，额头皱成了一个‘川’字，胡子有些脏乱，一顶尖尖的魔法帽戴在头上，掩住了白色的头发。
浑浊无神的眼睛打量了文森一眼，便又看向窗外。
“听说老法师以前是圣灵法师？”文森漫不经心的问道。
克索斯好似没听见，依旧望着窗外。
文森也不在意，从无尽之空中，将一团七彩的雾状漩涡取出。这团漩涡十分美丽，时不时闪烁着七彩光芒，云雾翻腾。
同时，一道道强烈的魔法波动从七彩雾状漩涡中透出。
强烈的魔法波动堪比史诗级法师！
文森双手托着七彩雾状漩涡，额头冷汗直冒，显然这团七彩雾状漩涡并不是普通物品！
原本像是哑巴的克索斯霍然站起，浑浊的双眼陡然清澈，神情激动的问道：“年轻人，你手中的可是元素之海里的元素之心？”
“是啊，这是元素之心，能够代替破碎的魔力之源，让魔法师重生！”文森笑着解释道。同时，他心中惊讶，原来这个世界也有元素之海！
看来，这个世界和魔武世界有些相似啊！
“年轻人，你有什么要求？”克索斯接近八十岁了，什么样的世面没见过？他可不相信一个素不相识的人会送给他一颗元素之心！
元素之心，绝对是无价之宝！

“尊敬的圣灵法师，很简单的条件！”文森想了想，他初来这个世界很多东西都不明白，克索斯曾经是圣灵法师，接近巅峰的强者，必定对这个世界十分了解。因此，他想将克索斯留在身边。
“我需要一位管家，帮我处理一些我不擅长的事物。”
克索斯上下打量了一番文森，点头道：“如此年轻的中位高级魔法师，倒是十分罕见。那边那头疾风贪狼也是你的么？”
文森点头，“是的，那是我的坐骑！你知道的，我虽然是中位高级魔法师，这样的实力在同辈中还算不错。不过嘛，遇上了比我年纪大的，那就吃亏了。所以，那个吃货偶尔也扮演一下保镖的角色！”
“自我介绍一下，我叫文森－奥古斯丁，来自一个遥远的地方。”
克索斯摘下了法师尖帽，微微欠身道：“克索斯－埃萨，向您问安！”
“克索斯法师，对于我的提议，你的意见如何？”
“如您所愿，尊敬的文森少爷。”克索斯再次欠身道。
文森哈哈大笑起来，将元素之心递给克索斯道：“克索斯管家，今日，你将重新踏上巅峰之路！”
即使是已经八十岁的克索斯，这一刻也不禁老泪纵横。想想他曾经作为圣灵法师的时候，多么多么的受人敬仰，受人尊敬。
想想那时候他的地位有多么的崇高，简直是亿万人敬仰！
可是，当他失去一身魔力后，他的生活简直是发生了天翻地覆的变化！
白眼、鄙视、嘲讽、调侃
对于一个失去魔力的老人来说，这实在是太糟糕了！
如今，他终于看见了希望！一个重新变强的希望！
克索斯颤抖的接过元素之心，缓缓将元素之心捧到额头处，然后狠狠的将它摁入精神之海。
“嗡~~”
“嗡~~~嗡~~~”
奇迹酒楼大厅中，突然想起一股如同蜜蜂振翅的声音，开始还很微弱，随后就变得十分洪亮，甚至有些刺耳！
站在克索斯身边的文森向后退了几步，站到了疾风贪狼身后。

“噼啪~~~”
克索斯身边，一道道电光虚空交错，宛如一条条择人而噬的银蛇！
银蛇环绕，逐渐交织成一个银光闪闪的大茧，把克索斯包裹在内。
文森微微惊讶，这个克索斯居然是罕见的雷系法师！
克伦蒂亚世界的元素力量，一般分为基础元素力量和衍生元素力量，其中基础元素分别是水系、火系、土系、风系、木系，光明系、黑暗系、空间系、精神系，其中木系一般多在精灵生活区域出现，衍生元素力量则是有很多，比如水系衍生的冰系，水系风系共同衍生的雾系，水系木系共同衍生的毒系，火系衍生的炎系，火风衍生的雷系等等，各种偏门的魔法力量数不胜数！
雷系魔法师在众多系别中，攻击力十分出众！
银色大茧一张一缩，脉动十分有力，仿佛在孕育着什么惊天动地的传奇。
而原本热闹的大厅中，此刻已经静悄悄一片，银色大茧周围，空荡一片，所有人都承受不住银色大茧隐隐传出的威压！
众人中，只有躲在疾风贪狼身后的文森和阿莱格拉距离最近。
文森眉间一片欣喜之色，原本以为这颗元素之心只能让克索斯恢复到大魔导师的境界，毕竟当初魔武世界中，他那个朋友也只恢复到了中位大魔导师的程度。
不过，根据从银色大茧中传出的威压，那显然是史诗级法师啊！
史诗法师虽然在阶位上，只是比大魔导师高一个阶位，但是，这一个阶位却是天壤之别！
一千个、一万个、甚至更多的大魔导师中，也不见得有一个能晋升为史诗法师！
史诗，多么崇高的称号！
一个文明、一段历史的史诗！
用最简单的话来说，一百个大魔导师，不一定打得过一个史诗法师！
如果史诗法师不要脸不要皮，那大魔导师，基本是毫无机会的。
“噼啪~噼啪”
银色大茧噼里啪啦的炸响，随即轰然炸开！
克索斯原本如同枯树皮一般皱起的皮肤，此时已经恢复了平滑，苍白的脸庞变得红润异常，眼神深邃无比！

“哈哈哈哈~~~~~~~”
“哈哈哈哈~~~~~~~~~~~~~”
“我克索斯，终于恢复了魔力！！！！！”
“那些曾经嘲笑我的，那些曾经欺辱我的，那些曾经蔑视我的，我要让他们统统都看看，我如今已经恢复了初位史诗级实力。即使再次登上圣灵位，也大有希望！”
克索斯大笑大吼，眼泪无声的流了出来。
他走到文森对面，深深的躬下身，带着感激道：“尊敬的文森少爷，以后克索斯－埃萨将成为您最忠诚的管家。您的意志，将是我的努力的方向；您的敌人，将是我毁灭的对象；请您接受我，史诗级魔法师，克索斯－埃萨，最忠诚的效忠。”
文森瞥了一眼脸色发黑的德克兰，微笑道：“我接受你的效忠，克索斯管家。”
————————————————————————————————————————————

content_en:
FS009 Holy Spirit Follows
In the world of magic and martial arts, one of Vincent's friends, a mythical powerhouse, once fell into the world because of a fight for the essence of Ziling when he was at the Holy Spirit level.
However, after the fall, the Holy Spirit did not remain silent forever. Instead, it stood up again and ascended the altar, creating a myth of rebirth from the ashes!
The reason for such a fundamental change is that the fallen Holy Spirit was a magic potion master!
He has mastered a magic potion formula inherited from ancient times, which can regenerate the broken source of magic!
Vincent also knows this potion formula, and most of the potions are available in Endless Sky. It just lacks some magic potions unique to the abyss.
Thinking of this, Vincent stood up and walked towards Xos, and sat directly on the chair next to Xos.
Xosos's face was unnaturally pale, his forehead was wrinkled into the word "Chuan", his beard was a little dirty, and a pointed magic hat was placed on his head, covering his white hair.
His cloudy and dull eyes looked at Vincent for a moment, then looked out the window again.
"I heard that the old mage used to be a Holy Spirit mage?" Vincent asked casually.
Xosos didn't seem to hear, still looking out the window.
Vincent didn't care and took out a colorful mist-like vortex from the endless sky. This whirlpool is very beautiful, with colorful lights flashing from time to time, and clouds and mist billowing.
At the same time, strong magic waves emerged from the colorful mist-like vortex.
The strong magic wave is comparable to an epic mage!
Vincent held the colorful mist-shaped vortex in his hands, and cold sweat broke out on his forehead. Obviously, this colorful mist-shaped vortex was not an ordinary item!
Xosos, who seemed to be mute at first, suddenly stood up, his cloudy eyes suddenly became clear, and he asked excitedly: "Young man, what is in your hand is the heart of the elements in the sea of elements?"
"Yes, this is the heart of elements, which can replace the broken source of magic and allow the magician to be reborn!" Vincent explained with a smile. At the same time, he was surprised that there was also a sea of ​​elements in this world!
It seems that this world is somewhat similar to the world of magic and martial arts!
"Young man, what do you want?" Xosos is nearly eighty years old. What kind of world has he not seen? He didn't believe that a stranger would give him an elemental heart!
The Heart of Elements is absolutely a priceless treasure!
"Dear Holy Spirit Mage, a very simple condition!" Vincent thought for a while. He didn't understand many things in this world when he first came to it. Xosos was once a Holy Spirit Mage. A strong man close to the top must know this world very well. Therefore, he wanted to keep Xos with him.
"I need a housekeeper to help me with things I'm not good at."
Xosos looked Vincent up and down, nodded and said: "Such a young mid-level high-level magician is very rare. Is that Gale Greedy Wolf over there also yours?"
Vincent nodded, "Yes, that's my mount! You know, although I am a mid-level high-level magician, my strength is pretty good among my peers. But, if I meet someone older than me, I will suffer a loss. So, that foodie also plays the role of a bodyguard from time to time!"
"Let me introduce myself. My name is Vincent Augustine. I come from a far away place."
Xosos took off the mage's pointed hat, bowed slightly and said: "Xosos-Essa, I say hello to you!"
"Mage Xosos, what do you think of my proposal?"
"As you wish, respected Master Vincent." Xosos bowed again.
Vincent burst into laughter, handed the Heart of Elements to Kesos and said, "Butler Kesos, today, you will set foot on the road to the top again!"
Even Xosos, who was already eighty years old, couldn't help but burst into tears at this moment. Think about how much he was admired and respected by everyone when he was a Holy Spirit Mage.
Think about how lofty his status was at that time, admired by hundreds of millions of people!
However, when heAfter losing his magic power, his life has undergone earth-shaking changes!
Rolling eyes, contempt, ridicule, ridicule
Too bad for an old man who has lost his mojo!
Now, he finally sees hope! A hope to become stronger again!
Xosos took the Heart of Elements tremblingly, slowly held it to his forehead, and then pressed it hard into the sea of ​​spirit.
"Buzz~~"
"Buzz~~~Buzz~~~"
In the lobby of the Miracle Restaurant, I suddenly remembered a sound like the flapping of bees' wings. It was very weak at first, and then became very loud, even a bit harsh!
Vincent, who was standing next to Xosos, took a few steps back and stood behind Gale Greedy Wolf.
"Crack~~~"
Beside Xosos, streaks of lightning criss-crossed the void, like silver snakes that chose people to eat!
The silver snakes surrounded him and gradually intertwined into a large silver cocoon, wrapping Xosos inside.
Vincent was slightly surprised. This Kesos was actually a rare thunder mage!
The elemental power in the world of Krentia is generally divided into basic elemental power and derived elemental power. The basic elements are water, fire, earth, wind, wood, light, dark, space, and spiritual. The wood element is generally found in elves. When an area appears, there are many derived elemental powers, such as the ice element derived from the water element, the fog element derived from the water and wind elements, the poison element derived from the water and wood elements, the fire element derived from the fire element, the thunder element derived from the fire and wind, etc. There are countless magical powers from various side branches!
Among many types of lightning magicians, the attack power is very outstanding!
The big silver cocoon opened and shrank, pulsing very powerfully, as if it was nurturing some earth-shattering legend.
The originally lively hall was now completely silent, and the area around the silver cocoon was completely empty. No one could bear the faint pressure coming from the silver cocoon!
Among the people, only Vincent and Allegra, who were hiding behind Gale Greedy Wolf, were the closest.
Vincent's brows were filled with joy. He originally thought that this elemental heart could only restore Xosos to the realm of a great mage. After all, in the world of magic and martial arts, his friend had only recovered to the level of a mid-level great mage.
However, based on the pressure coming from the silver cocoon, it was obviously an epic mage!
Although the epic mage is only one level higher than the great mage, this level is completely different!
Among a thousand, ten thousand, or even more great magisters, not even one may be promoted to an epic mage!
Epic, what a noble title!
An epic of civilization and history!
To put it in the simplest terms, a hundred great magisters may not be able to defeat one epic mage!
If the epic mage is shameless, then the great mage basically has no chance.
"Crack~Crack"
The big silver cocoon crackled and exploded immediately!
Xosos's skin, which was originally wrinkled like dry tree bark, has now returned to smoothness, his pale face has become unusually rosy, and his eyes are extremely deep!
"Hahahaha~~~~~~~"
"Hahahaha~~~~~~~~~~~~~"
"I, Xos, finally regained my magic power!!!!"
"Those who used to laugh at me, those who used to bully me, those who used to despise me, I want them all to see that I have now restored my first epic level strength. Even if I ascend to the throne of the Holy Spirit again, there is great hope!"
Xosos laughed and roared, tears streaming down his face silently.
He walked to the opposite side of Vincent, bowed deeply, and said with gratitude: "Dear Master Vincent, in the future, Xosos-Essa will be your most loyal steward. Your will will be the direction of my efforts; your enemies will be the objects of my destruction; please accept me, the epic magician, Xos-Essa, the most loyal steward."Loyal. "
Vincent glanced at Declan, whose face turned dark, and smiled: "I accept your allegiance, Steward Xos. "
